title: List
description: Fiori list: standard / custom items, groups, selection modes (single, multiple, delete…), growing, roving focus.

usage.summary: Present a sequence of business items for browsing, navigation or selection without column comparison.
useWhen: Show a few attributes per item with ListItemStandard, or compose custom item content with ListItemCustom.
Group a flat collection with ListItemGroup instead of adding expandable hierarchy.
Enable selectionMode="single" or "multiple" for item choice; use growing="button" or "scroll" with onLoadMore to request more items.

avoidWhen.when: Compare several attributes across aligned columns.
Browse nested parent-child relationships that users must expand or collapse.
Choose one value from a short list inside a field.
Type to narrow a single-value choice or enter a new value.
